preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to modify tax configurations
Contract must have accumulated tokens >= swapTokensAtAmount to trigger swapAndLiquify
Trading must be enabled for transfers to trigger swap mechanism

exploit_hint: 1. As owner, call setTaxes/setSellTaxes to configure tax values that create precision issues in the denominator calculation (line 578: denominator = (liquidity + marketing + Stake + Dapp) * 2). 2. Ensure contract accumulates tokens >= swapTokensAtAmount through normal transfers. 3. Trigger a transfer to the pair address to execute swapAndLiquify. 4. The skewed denominator calculation causes disproportionate BNB distribution to marketing/Staking/Dapp wallets controlled by attacker, draining contract funds through precision manipulation in unitBalance = deltaBalance / (denominator - temp.liquidity).
